o: Someone wronged by Diabla both in the past and present returns to get justice, but also stirs up old feelings that create tensions among the Santanas.

eps.o: Marcial finds out that Titi was behind the hospital attack. Catalina and her family make it to Colombia. La Diabla becomes Amparo to cross the border.
While Albeiro and Hernán Darío take Hilda to the hospital, Titi's hitmen take advantage of the opportunity to attack the house.
Marcial and Catalina la Grande are reunited after 20 years and he apologizes to her. Catalina la Pequeña feels guilty for murdering two men.
Marcial tells Titi that he's ready to die. Catalina la Grande and Santiago invite Albeiro and Hernán Darío to spend the night at their house.
La Diabla makes it to Pereira. Everyone realizes that Marcial has died and that Titi is behind it. Catalina la Grande remembers her time with Marcial.
Las Diablas reach the new ranch and plan to build an emergency tunnel. Hilda recovers part of her memory but she is referred to a psychiatrist.
Chuky burns the money that Daniela hid. The Captain is going to frame Chuky for Marcial's death. La Diabla stays on the street.
The police arrest Albeiro and Jota for burning down Las Diablas' house. Yésica is furious when Daniela admits that she slept with Titi.
Mariana gets naked in front of Hernán Darío. Catalina la Grande sees them together and Mariana cuts her veins. Hilda is taken to the psychiatric ward.
Martín tells Virginia how to get to Titi and Gato Gordo: by moving to their old neighborhood. The agent traps Martina and wants her to be a TEA spy.
Hilda digs up the past and throws it in Virginia's face in front of Santiago. Mayra and Flavia join Las Diablas to set up a new cartel in Mexico City.
Gato Gordo and Titi film their meeting with their partners. Daniela suggests that Titi kill Gato Gordo. Nacho is disappointed by Catalina la Pequeña.
Calvo and his men attack Gato Gordo's ranch but he manages to escape with Titi. Las Diablas and Flavia prepare Mayra to become the cocaine queen.
Albeiro and Jota get out of jail. Gato Gordo wants to make a claim about the attack on his ranch. Chuky organizes a vigil for Marcial.
Titi suspects that Daniela gave the order to kill him so he confronts her but she denies it. Yésica changes her plan: she'll have to do it herself.
Virginia starts acting as an undercover agent in front of Paola and Martina. Gato Gordo gets shot in a fight.
Titi is excited to hear Catalina la Grande's voice and wants to see her. She shows up in the neighborhood and sees her old friends.
Catalina la Pequeña hears her sister yelling at her daughter and finds out what happened with Hernán Darío. Titi dreams of being number one.
A heartbroken Catalina la Pequeña confronts Hernán Darío about his betrayal. La Diabla and Chalo plan to eliminate Gato Gordo and Titi in Mexico.
Virginia plays the role of Catalina Santana on her date with Titi. He is thrilled and invites her to Mexico. Martin organizes an operation.
Virginia and Titi get to Chalo's ranch in Mexico but the TEA is on their tail. Las Diablas' hitmen kidnap Hilda at Marcial's burial.
Titi shoots Chalo and gunfire commences. Catalina la Grande joins in and Titi is surprised that she can use a gun. The TEA shows up at the ranch
Virginia pretends to be sick and Titi goes out to get her medicine. She uses the opportunity to give Martín their location.
Titi manages to flee the TEA. Virginia asks Martín to arrest her so that Titi isn't suspicious and he agrees so that she won't go back to Colombia.
Martín secretly takes Virginia to a rented house. Aníbal get to Daniela's "aunt's" house. She seduces him and Yésica shows up to torture him.
Virginia thinks that Martín is helping her but he has different intentions. Mariana manipulates Catalina la Pequeña.
Martín holds Virginia against her will and declares his love for her. La Diabla gets revenge and Titi looks for Chalo's competition.
La Diabla demands that Calvo seduce Hilda. Gato Gordo is at death's door but he has two last requests: one has to do with a crime.
Catalina tries to trick Martín so that she can escape. The policeman is clever and she swears her revenge. Santiago finds Martín.
Albeiro goes to Yésica's ranch to negotiate Hilda's freedom. Mayra pretends to be a narco by following La Diabla's instructions.
Albeiro insists on negotiating Hilda's freedom. Mariana goes to a drunk Nacho's house. She pretends to be Catalina la Pequeña to confuse him.
Mariana plays with Catalina la Pequeña's excitement. Catalina la Grande finds out that Hilda has been kidnapped. The past surprises Santiago.
Albeiro sends a drone to find Hilda. Daniela and La Diabla go to Aníbal's funeral. Yésica speaks to the governor. Titi calls Martina about business.
Hilda hides from Calvo and La Diabla realizes that they're not there. Daniela glimpses a drone and warns her mother that she might be recognized.
Catalina la Grande tries to find Santiago and his kids but he makes an irreversible decision and leaves a letter. Nachito wants to rescue his love.
Martina tries to kill Titi for all the humiliation he caused her. Catalina la Pequeña is suspicious of Mariana and talks to Hernán Darío.
Catalina la Grande and co. get ready to confront Las Diablas. Mariana and Sebastián leave because of their parents. Nacho tries to clear his name.
Catalina la Grande shows up heavily armed at Las Diablas' ranch and sparks a massacre. Hilda refuses to go with her family and everyone is shocked.
La Diabla takes Hilda to her new hiding place. A furious Catalina la Pequeña strangles Daniela. Catalina la Grande can't find her children.
Daniela escapes. Catalina la Grande is alone and suffering after her children and husband abandon her. Hilda considers teaming up with Yésica.
Albeiro and Yésica set up a meeting to exchange hostages. Catalina la Grande meets the new TEA boss. The new neighborhood pimp, Dayana, meets Titi.
Yésica coordinates the meeting with Albeiro for the exchange. The neighborhood pimp goes after Mariana and is surprised to see Catalina.
Catalina la Grande and her boss set up a secure area for the exchange. Dayana is ready to start recruiting her next victim: Mariana.
Gunfire starts at the exchange and Albeiro and Jota are trapped. Dayana gives Mariana a hallucinogenic and she takes it, unaware of the consequences.
Mariana is out of her mind due to the drugs and alcohol. She hallucinates that Titi is Hernán Darío and asks him to impregnate her.
Mariana is repulsed after unabashedly sleeping with Titi. Yésica coerces Albeiro into her bed and takes photos to show Hilda.
Catalina la Grande tells Mariana that she can get marijuana under three conditions. Hilda sends Albeiro a video message.
Yésica fantasizes about having a family with Albeiro. Catalina la Grande is planning to track Daniela so she can find La Diabla.
Catalina la Pequeña puts a tracker on Daniela and lets her go free. The TEA and the police take action. Gatillo betrays Las Diablas.
Mariana is willing to go to extremes to get Hernán. At Titi's request, Dayana convinces Mariana to visit him again.
Titi organizes Mariana's big birthday party. Catalina la Grande gives her daughter marijuana. Santiago tries to forget Catalina.
Las Diablas go to see the witch Abigail and Daniela asks her for some help. Catalina la Pequeña walks in on Hernán Darío and Dayana together.
La Diabla freezes Albeiro's semen so she can have his child. Hilda calls Albeiro out for his infidelity. Las Diablas show up in the neighborhood.
Yésica goes to an artificial insemination clinic. Hilda admits her feelings for Calvo to Albeiro. La Diabla hears from a secret admirer.
Las Diablas make it to Chalo's ranch and he decides to give Daniela the house. Catalina la Pequeña and Vanessa plan a trap. Dayana gets a beating.
Catalina la Grande finds out that Chalo is still alive and that he and La Diabla want to kill her. Hilda says that she'll never get back with Albeiro.
Albeiro is hurt by Hilda and turns to alcohol. Chalo has a proposition for Daniela. Everyone goes to Paola's daughter's funeral.
Yésica gives Albeiro a concoction that the witch Abigail prepared. Mariana goes to the birthday party Titi is throwing and he gives her a fancy gift.
Everything has a price for Las Diablas. The TEA deploys an operative to trap Yésica Beltrán. Daniel unleashes Daniela's fury.
Hours before the pageant, La Diabla tries to sway the judges' votes, unaware Catalina la Grande and her TEA partners are planning to capture her.
